Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)

Corporate Energy Buyers Association      jmiller@ceba.org                         kdavis@ceba.org                         

Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rule 214 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, 18 C.F.R. § 385.214, Corporate Energy Buyers Association (CEBA) hereby respectfully moves to intervene.

CEBA is a business association that activates energy buyers and their partners to drive low-cost, reliable, carbon emissions-free global energy systems. Our members represent $40 trillion in market value, including energy customers of all sizes, suppliers, and service providers.

CEBA members are bringing, or plan to bring, large loads to the PJM region. PJM’s proposal thus directly impacts the ability of our members to procure and access the affordable, reliable energy they need to power operations as they invest in the region. For these reasons, CEBA has a substantial interest in this proceeding that cannot be adequately represented by another party, and its participation is in the public interest.
